best_season.from: A cold window in May is the consensus best time: long days, a stable and still-continuous snowpack, and a bergschrund that has not yet opened. Reports consistently warn that waiting until June is problematic because the schrund opens rapidly. Early May trips have found powder rather than ice on the headwall. Winter ascents have been made (January and early May are both documented) but require biking or skiing in from the SR 20 closure gate and full avalanche, cornice and crevasse competence. This route is emphatically not a late-summer objective.
